repo.title: ThunderID <accent>Samples</accent>
repo.desc: Ready-to-run sample apps that show ThunderID features in action, organized by feature area and downloadable with every release.

samples.title: Android <accent>Quickstart</accent>
samples.desc: A Jetpack Compose app that signs users in with the ThunderID Android SDK and shows their profile.

samples.title: Browser <accent>Quickstart</accent>
samples.desc: A framework-free JavaScript app that signs users in with @thunderid/browser.

samples.title: Express <accent>Quickstart</accent>
samples.desc: An Express server that signs users in with @thunderid/express and protects its routes.

samples.title: Flutter <accent>Quickstart</accent>
samples.desc: A Flutter app for iOS and Android that signs users in with the thunderid_flutter package.

samples.title: iOS <accent>Quickstart</accent>
samples.desc: A SwiftUI app that signs users in with the ThunderID iOS SDK and shows their profile.

samples.title: Next.js <accent>Quickstart</accent>
samples.desc: A Next.js App Router app that signs users in with @thunderid/nextjs, on the client and the server.

samples.title: Node.js <accent>Quickstart</accent>
samples.desc: A Node.js service that gets its own access token with @thunderid/node for machine-to-machine calls.

samples.title: Nuxt <accent>Quickstart</accent>
samples.desc: A Nuxt app that signs users in with @thunderid/nuxt, with server-side sessions.

samples.title: React <accent>Quickstart</accent>
samples.desc: A React and Vite app that signs users in with @thunderid/react and shows their profile and tokens.

samples.title: Vue <accent>Quickstart</accent>
samples.desc: A Vue and Vite app that signs users in with @thunderid/vue and shows their profile.

samples.title: Better Auth <accent>+ Next.js</accent>
samples.desc: Sign in to a Next.js app through Better Auth's Generic OAuth plugin and the @thunderid/better-auth helper.

samples.title: Flutter <accent>AppAuth</accent>
samples.desc: Sign in to a Flutter app with the flutter_appauth plugin, using authorization code and PKCE.

samples.title: React <accent>+ Express BFF</accent>
samples.desc: A React app that signs in through an Express BFF, which keeps tokens on the server with @thunderid/express and handles back-channel logout.

samples.title: Account <accent>App</accent>
samples.desc: A React app where users view and edit their own profile and change their password.

samples.title: Admin <accent>App</accent>
samples.desc: A React app where an administrator manages users, groups, roles, applications and agents with @thunderid/react.
